conditions.western_pathology_en: Chronic sequelae after prior upper-genital-tract inflammation can include tubal damage/adhesions, chronic pelvic pain, infertility risk, or ectopic-pregnancy risk; the label does not prove persistent active infection.
conditions.western_pathology_zh: 既往上生殖道發炎後可留下輸卵管損傷／沾黏、慢性骨盆痛、不孕或子宮外孕風險；此標籤不代表仍有活動性感染。
conditions.etiology_en: Prior PID is the initiating context; gonorrhea and chlamydia are important causes, but PID is polymicrobial.
conditions.etiology_zh: 起始背景為既往 PID；淋病與披衣菌重要，但 PID 可為多微生物性。

sources.title: Pelvic Inflammatory Disease (PID) - STI Treatment Guidelines

structured_relation_seeds.target_text: ectopic pregnancy risk after tubal damage

conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_seed_zh: 下焦濕熱餘邪、氣滯、血瘀或虛實夾雜候選；需依現況辨證。
conditions.identity_note: Sequela identity; do not infer active infection.

conditions.western_pathology_en: A debated deep-gluteal sciatic-nerve irritation/entrapment construct. Buttock pain, sitting-provoked symptoms, deep-gluteal tenderness, and provocation with piriformis tension are reported, but criteria are not fully standardized.
conditions.western_pathology_zh: 具爭議性的深臀區坐骨神經刺激／壓迫概念；常見臀痛、久坐誘發與深臀壓痛，但診斷標準未完全一致。
conditions.etiology_en: Proposed mechanisms include non-discogenic sciatic-nerve entrapment related to local anatomy, trauma, or repetitive loading; no single mechanism is established.
conditions.etiology_zh: 提出機轉包括非椎間盤來源坐骨神經壓迫、局部解剖、外傷或反覆負荷，尚無單一確立機轉。

sources.title: Four symptoms define the piriformis syndrome

conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_seed_zh: 經筋痹阻、氣血不暢、血瘀候選；神經定位仍屬西醫評估。

conditions.western_pathology_en: A severe cyclical premenstrual disorder with affective/behavioral/physical symptoms linked to the menstrual cycle and clinically meaningful distress or impairment.
conditions.western_pathology_zh: 嚴重週期性經前疾患，情緒／行為／身體症狀隨月經週期出現並造成明顯困擾或功能受損。
conditions.etiology_en: Likely reflects abnormal sensitivity to normal ovarian-steroid fluctuation with neurobiologic effects rather than a single structural lesion.
conditions.etiology_zh: 較可能是對正常卵巢類固醇波動的異常敏感與神經生物效應，而非單一結構病灶。
conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_seed_zh: 肝鬱、肝脾不和、痰火、血虛或腎系候選，依週期與全身表現辨證。
conditions.identity_note: Specific cyclical disorder; not a loose PMS synonym.

conditions.western_pathology_en: Perceived or actual insufficient milk production/transfer. Assessment must distinguish low production from ineffective milk removal/transfer and evaluate the maternal-infant dyad.
conditions.western_pathology_zh: 可指主觀或實際乳量／轉乳不足；需區分產乳不足與排乳／轉乳效率不佳，並同時評估母嬰。
conditions.etiology_en: Contributors include inadequate stimulation/removal, latch or transfer problems, delayed lactogenesis, maternal physiologic/endocrine factors, selected medications/illness, and infant factors.
conditions.etiology_zh: 因素包括刺激／排乳不足、含乳或轉乳問題、泌乳延遲、母體生理／內分泌、部分藥物疾病與嬰兒因素。

structured_relation_seeds.target_text: infant inadequate weight gain or dehydration risk
perceived low supply with adequate intake

conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_seed_zh: 氣血不足、脾胃虛弱或肝鬱候選，依乳量、疲倦、情志、舌脈辨證。
conditions.identity_note: Infant intake/hydration/jaundice/weight trajectory is safety priority.

conditions.western_pathology_en: Rotator-cuff tendon pain/tendinopathy or tendinitis, distinct from a full-thickness tear. Repeated loading can irritate tendon/subacromial structures and provoke pain with elevation or overhead use.
conditions.western_pathology_zh: 旋轉肌袖肌腱疼痛／肌腱病變或肌腱炎，須與全層撕裂區分；反覆負荷可刺激肌腱與肩峰下結構。
conditions.etiology_en: Repetitive overhead load, repeated lifting, age-related degeneration, and minor injury can contribute.
conditions.etiology_zh: 反覆過頭負荷、搬舉、年齡性退變與輕微外傷可參與。
conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_seed_zh: 經筋痹阻、氣滯、血瘀或痹證候選，依起病、無力、寒熱與檢查辨證。

conditions.western_pathology_en: Menstrual pain caused by an underlying reproductive-organ disorder rather than primary prostaglandin-mediated cramps; pain may begin earlier, last longer, or worsen over time.
conditions.western_pathology_zh: 由生殖器官潛在疾病造成的經痛，不同於原發性經痛；可較早開始、持續更久或逐漸加重。
conditions.etiology_en: Underlying causes include endometriosis, adenomyosis, fibroids, PID, and selected structural/congenital disorders.
conditions.etiology_zh: 原因可包括子宮內膜異位、腺肌症、肌瘤、PID 與部分結構／先天異常。
risk_factors_en: new significant pain after previously painless cycles
conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_seed_zh: 氣滯、血瘀、寒凝、濕熱或虛證候選；西醫病因與中醫證型分開。
conditions.identity_note: Do not collapse into primary dysmenorrhea.

conditions.western_pathology_en: Symptomatic vulvovaginal candidiasis is most often caused by C. albicans; symptoms such as pruritus, soreness, dysuria, dyspareunia, and discharge are not specific, so diagnosis should not rest on symptoms alone.
conditions.western_pathology_zh: 多由 C. albicans 造成；搔癢、疼痛、排尿痛、性交痛與分泌物皆不具特異性，不能只靠症狀診斷。
conditions.etiology_en: Candida causes symptomatic infection; recurrent/complicated cases may involve host factors or non-albicans species, while many uncomplicated cases lack an identifiable precipitant.
conditions.etiology_zh: Candida 造成症狀性感染；復發／複雜病例可涉及宿主因素或非 albicans 菌種，許多單純病例則無明確誘因。
risk_factors_en: many uncomplicated cases have no clear trigger
conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_seed_zh: 濕熱或虛證夾濕候選，依帶下、氣味、熱象、復發性與舌脈辨證。
conditions.identity_note: Usually not an STI; avoid STI inference from diagnosis alone.

conditions.western_pathology_en: Cervical-spine/supporting-structure injury produced by acceleration-deceleration force. Symptoms may include neck pain, stiffness, headache, or neurologic complaints; collision label alone does not determine severity/prognosis.
conditions.western_pathology_zh: 加速－減速力量造成的頸椎及支持結構損傷；可有頸痛、僵硬、頭痛或神經症狀，但不能只用碰撞標籤推定嚴重度。
conditions.etiology_en: Most often follows motor-vehicle collision; falls, contact-sport collisions, or diving can also cause this injury pattern.
conditions.etiology_zh: 最常見於汽車碰撞，也可見於跌倒、接觸運動或跳水。
risk_factors_en: prior cervical problems may affect symptom burden
conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_seed_zh: 氣滯、血瘀、經筋損傷候選；神經與結構紅旗優先西醫評估。

conditions.source_support_note: AAOS supports ligament sprain, common inversion/lateral mechanism, prior-sprain recurrence risk, and chronic instability.

structured_relation_seeds.target_text: chronic ankle instability after recurrent/incompletely rehabilitated sprain

conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_seed_zh: 氣血壅滯、血瘀、經筋損傷候選。

conditions.source_support_note: ACOG supports a ≥6-month, often multifactorial syndrome spanning gynecologic, urinary, GI, musculoskeletal, and pain-processing contributors.
conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_seed_zh: 氣滯、血瘀、濕熱、寒、虛或虛實夾雜候選。
conditions.identity_note: Umbrella syndrome; 11 unresolved crossrefs must not be auto-resolved.

conditions.source_support_note: ICHD-3 is the diagnostic/classification anchor and supports placement among trigeminal autonomic cephalalgias.
conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_seed_zh: 經絡、肝、痰、火、血瘀或虛證候選，與 ICHD 診斷分開。

conditions.source_support_note: AAOS supports APL/EPB tendon-sheath irritation, pregnancy/postpartum association, and thumb/wrist loading as symptom aggravators.
conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_seed_zh: 經筋痹阻、氣滯或血瘀候選。

conditions.source_support_note: ASRM supports a multifactorial evaluation including ovulation, reproductive-tract structure/patency, age/context, and semen evaluation when applicable.

sources.title: Fertility evaluation of infertile women: committee opinion

conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_seed_zh: 無固定單一證型；腎、沖任、肝、脾、氣血、痰濕、寒熱、瘀依個案判斷。
conditions.identity_note: Multifactorial umbrella; do not equate with one cause.

conditions.source_support_note: AUA/ASRM guideline hosted by ASRM supports reproductive history, semen analysis, directed evaluation, and concurrent couple assessment.

sources.title: Diagnosis and treatment of infertility in men: guideline part I

conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_seed_zh: 無固定單一證型；腎精、腎陰陽、肝氣、濕熱、痰、氣血與瘀依個案判斷。
conditions.identity_note: Multifactorial umbrella; preserve existing core detail.

conditions.source_support_note: AAPM&R describes regional myofascial pain/trigger-point features and chronic stretch/overload contributors; diagnostic/mechanistic uncertainty remains.

conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_seed_zh: 氣滯、血瘀、經筋痹阻、痹證或虛證候選。
conditions.identity_note: Mechanisms/criteria debated; do not portray trigger points as a uniquely proven lesion.
